primary: test whether changes in review yield from the actual source-selected queues translate to downstream accuracy
source: fixed published destination and random vs difficulty masks, 20% source noise; source winners are the CNN margin and CNN 10NN respectively
CIFAR-10N: cycle through the ten original target splits; assign all three individual human labels nearly equally using a fixed rotation
CIFAR-10H: the 100 frozen human vote draws, each over the original target images
count_matched: diagnostic: keep corrections common to both detector queues and uniformly thin the higher-yield queue's unique corrections to the lower count, then compare with the lower-yield queue; pay the original review budget
training: archived 3-convolution PlainCNN from scratch, identical 12 epochs, initialization, batch order, and image augmentation within each seed; same optimizer and recipe as downstream100
external_test: CIFAR-10.1 v6 fixed pinned release d9982abb0bfc4846b8d13a11e66b887d946205d0, no validation/model selection; check exact duplicates against all CIFAR-10 images
secondary_test: official CIFAR-10 test, only for CIFAR-10N-trained models
